<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="cabinet">
  <!-- Cabinet carcass: 1.10 m wide, 0.57 m deep (doors add 0.02 m), 1.83 m tall.
       Origin on the floor, centred in X and Y. Front faces -Y. -->
  <link name="cabinet_body">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0.01 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="40.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="12.246" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="5.1163" iyz="0.0"
               izz="15.1963"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0.01 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.10 0.57 1.83"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood">
        <color rgba="0.55 0.35 0.18 1.0"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0.01 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.10 0.57 1.83"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Left door: hinged at x = -0.55, extends toward the centre (x = 0). -->
  <link name="door_left">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0.275 0.01 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="8.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="2.23287" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.201933" iyz="0.0"
               izz="2.43427"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.275 0.01 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.55 0.02 1.83"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.275 0.01 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.55 0.02 1.83"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Right door: hinged at x = +0.55, extends toward the centre (x = 0). -->
  <link name="door_right">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="-0.275 0.01 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="8.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="2.23287" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.201933" iyz="0.0"
               izz="2.43427"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.275 0.01 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.55 0.02 1.83"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.275 0.01 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.55 0.02 1.83"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Left hinge: vertical axis at the left front edge.
       Negative rotation swings the door outward (toward -Y). -->
  <joint name="hinge_left" type="revolute">
    <parent link="cabinet_body"/>
    <child link="door_left"/>
    <origin xyz="-0.55 -0.295 0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 0 1"/>
    <limit lower="-1.5708" upper="0.0" effort="25.0" velocity="2.0"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.5" friction="0.1"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Right hinge: vertical axis at the right front edge.
       Positive rotation swings the door outward (toward -Y). -->
  <joint name="hinge_right" type="revolute">
    <parent link="cabinet_body"/>
    <child link="door_right"/>
    <origin xyz="0.55 -0.295 0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 0 1"/>
    <limit lower="0.0" upper="1.5708" effort="25.0" velocity="2.0"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.5" friction="0.1"/>
  </joint>
</robot>
